correctness.rationale: The intrinsic odd-scale nerve identity is Lemma 2.2 of Adams–Shukla–Singh. Complete constructive enumeration yields 30 six-vertex generating facets, f-vector (20,150,440,410,180,30), 1,230 faces. The verifier checks 472 genuine simplicial collapse pairs and a 590-pair complete acyclic Forman matching, including all 4,340 directed Hasse incidences and exactly one 0-cell and 49 2-cells critical. Forman's theorem yields a CW wedge of 49 spheres, hence integral homology, simple-connectedness and non-shellability of this pure 5-complex. Independent GF(2) checks yield boundary ranks 19,99. No infinite inference or other scales are claimed.

value.rationale: The 20-vertex Desargues graph is the canonical Levi graph of the ten-point/ten-line Desargues configuration, a symmetric cubic graph of girth six. Exact scale three is the first point outside the standard girth-controlled graph recovery regime. The new exact homotopy type and obstruction to shellability furnish motivated invariants and a reproducible comparison point, going beyond a Betti-only or arbitrary finite slice. No theorem for other girth-six graphs is asserted.
